##### Project general facts

Baliwood I and II is a collection of private villas by Breig Property built around a contemporary design that balances elegance with everyday functionality. The villas are offered in layouts ranging from two to five bedrooms, with a spacious kitchen and dining area at the heart of each home and a cosy lounge that flows out to the garden.

Every villa enjoys its own swimming pool and terrace on the ground level, along with a rooftop holding a second private pool and a lounge area for relaxing in the open air. A private car space is provided at the entrance, and the bedrooms are spread across levels to give each member of the household privacy.

Interiors combine natural materials with chic industrial finishes, and bedrooms come with their own bathrooms, some with outdoor bathtubs set in small gardens. The villas are delivered fully equipped and furnished, including decor and carefully selected plants, so they are ready to welcome residents or guests from the moment of arrival.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Canggu is a coastal area on the southwest coast of Bali where green rice paddies meet the Indian Ocean, with Pererenan on its calmer western edge. The area combines a laid-back Balinese atmosphere with well-regarded surf breaks along its beaches.

Residents have a wide choice of cafes, restaurants, beach clubs and boutique shops serving local and international cuisine. The open-air dining scene and seaside venues are spread throughout the neighbourhood, so everyday needs and leisure options are close at hand.

Canggu and Pererenan attract a steady flow of surfers, families and long-stay visitors, with accommodation ranging from guesthouses to luxury villas. This demand makes villas in the area attractive both for private living and as a source of rental income.
